LESSON: INTERDEPENDENCE OF PEOPLE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Interdependence of people
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

Welcome to this lesson on Interdependence of people. In Kenyan schools, learners explore this topic to understand how it connects to daily life in our communities. A key question we explore is: 2.0 People and Population
